items_flat.title_en: Google releases Gemini 3.7 Flash, its most intelligent workhorse model for coding and agents
items_flat.title_zh: Google 發布 Gemini 3.7 Flash，其最智能的編碼與代理工作馬模型
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced Gemini 3.7 Flash on August 13 as the most intelligent model in its Flash series for coding, knowledge work and agents. It delivers substantial gains over 3.6 Flash on coding benchmarks (FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%, DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49.0%) plus better web development and multi-step workflows, with introductory pricing of $0.75/$3.75 per million tokens (half of prior) through year-end.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 於 8 月 13 日宣布 Gemini 3.7 Flash，作為 Flash 系列最智能的編碼、知識工作與代理模型。相較 3.6 Flash，在編碼基準上大幅提升（FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%、DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49.0%），網頁開發與多步驟工作流程也更強，並提供年底前 $0.75/$3.75 每百萬 token 的半價導入定價。
items_flat.analysis_en: The three-week follow-up to 3.6 Flash plus aggressive intro pricing shows Google prioritising rapid iteration and cost-performance in the agentic workhorse segment. Key uncertainty is whether the benchmark gains translate consistently into fewer failed agent loops in production.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 距離 3.6 Flash 僅三週即推出，並搭配積極半價導入，顯示 Google 優先快速迭代與代理工作馬的成本效益。關鍵不確定性在於基準提升能否穩定轉化為生產環境中更少失敗的代理迴圈。
items_flat.quote: Our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們迄今最智能的編碼與代理工作馬模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14× the speed via Cerebras
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 預覽 Ultrafast 模式：GPT-5.6 Sol 透過 Cerebras 最高達 14 倍速度
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced Ultrafast, a new API tier that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14× faster than standard processing and generates up to 750 output tokens per second, powered by Cerebras. The limited preview is available today to a select group of customers, with expansion planned as capacity grows.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 Ultrafast 新 API 層級，讓 GPT-5.6 Sol 比標準處理最高快 14 倍，每秒可生成最高 750 個輸出 token，由 Cerebras 驅動。有限預覽今日開放給精選客戶，容量增加後將擴大。
items_flat.analysis_en: Pairing frontier intelligence with extreme speed removes a key barrier for real-time agentic and interactive applications. Uncertainty centres on when (and at what price) Ultrafast reaches broad availability.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將前沿智能與極致速度結合，移除即時代理與互動應用的關鍵障礙。不確定性在於 Ultrafast 何時（以及以何價格）全面開放。
items_flat.quote: Powered by Cerebras, Ultrafast generates up to 750 tokens per second, bringing our most intelligent model to products and workflows where every second counts.
items_flat.quote_zh: 由 Cerebras 驅動，Ultrafast 每秒可生成最高 750 個 token，將我們最智能的模型帶入每一秒都重要的產品與工作流程。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Computer History in ChatGPT desktop app for Mac
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT Mac 桌面版推出 Computer History
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released Computer History, an opt-in feature in the ChatGPT desktop app on macOS that records interaction events across selected apps and websites (not screenshots) to build a searchable timeline and memories. It replaces the Chronicle research preview and is rolling out to Pro, Business and Enterprise users.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布 Computer History，這是 ChatGPT macOS 桌面版的選擇性功能，記錄選定 App 與網站的互動事件（非螢幕截圖）以建立可搜尋時間軸與記憶。它取代 Chronicle 研究預覽，並向 Pro、Business 與 Enterprise 用戶推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Giving the model persistent, user-controlled context from the local desktop moves ChatGPT closer to a true personal agent. Privacy design and opt-in nature will determine real-world adoption.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 讓模型從本地桌面獲得持久且用戶可控的上下文，使 ChatGPT 更接近真正的個人代理。隱私設計與選擇加入機制將決定實際採用程度。
items_flat.quote: ChatGPT can now remember your activity across the apps and websites on your computer.
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT 現在可以記住你在電腦上各 App 與網站的活動。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic updates Claude Tag to read more of the room with ~30% better proactive decisions
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 更新 Claude Tag，更能讀懂氣氛，主動決策提升約 30%
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic released an update to Claude Tag (its Slack agent) that lets Claude use full channel context, memory and standing instructions to decide when and how to contribute. The model now chooses among four moves—reply inline, start a thread, route to existing work, or stay silent—and is roughly 30% better at proactive timing, with no extra cost.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 更新 Claude Tag（其 Slack 代理），讓 Claude 運用完整頻道上下文、記憶與既有指示來決定何時與如何貢獻。模型現可選擇四種行動——直接回覆、開新討論串、導向進行中工作或保持沉默——主動時機判斷約提升 30%，且無額外費用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moving from a simple classifier to richer context-aware behaviour makes Claude more useful as a collaborative agent rather than a reactive bot. Real-world value will depend on how reliably it avoids being annoying.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 從簡單分類器轉向更豐富的情境感知行為，使 Claude 更像協作代理而非被動機器人。實際價值將取決於它能否可靠地避免令人煩擾。
items_flat.quote: Claude Tag now reads even more of the room.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude Tag 現在更能讀懂氣氛。

Day focused on faster, smarter workhorse agents.
brief_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，編碼與代理能力大幅提升並半價導入。OpenAI 預覽 Ultrafast GPT-5.6 Sol（Cerebras 最高 14 倍速）並上線 Mac Computer History。Anthropic 讓 Claude Tag 主動決策提升約 30%。今日重點是更快更聰明的工作馬代理。
